programme.desc: In her hometown, Detective Ember Manning (Jenna Coleman) begins to experience a series of terrifying events.The investigator tries to solve their mystery.He checks whether the death of a risk-taking journalist, a fire that broke out on a boat, and an illegal relationship with minors have anything in common.When he seeks the truth, he does not agree to compromise.This time, however, the truth may prove dangerous to her orderly life.He must look at his past differently, understand the complicated present, and see the real face of the city he considers home.

programme.title: Blue Lights 2
programme.desc: Grace (Sian Brooke), Annie (Katherine Devlin) and Tommy (Nathan Braniff) are on duty in Belfast.They quickly discover that no training will prepare them for what they have to face - reality can be much more demanding and unpredictable.A year has passed since the dismantling of the McIntyre gang, but the vacuum left behind is immediately filled with new groups fighting for dominance.As tensions mount, the team is joined by Constable Shane Bradley (Frank Blake), whose intentions raise doubts among his colleagues.When a young loyalist begins to destabilize the fragile balance in the city, the police face the specter of a brutal confrontation.Their personal lives are equally turbulent.Tommy is considering going into intelligence more and more seriously, and Grace is struggling with missing her son and the feelings she begins to bond with one of the officers.
